title: Retirement readiness uses simulation and advisor handoff
message: Am I on track for retirement?
answer: The short version is that the plan still looks resilient, but the part I would watch is spending. title: Tax-budget rebalance shows realized gains and tax cap
message: Rebalance me but keep tax under $1,500.
answer: With a $1,500 tax budget, the rebalance can only sell part of the overweight lots. The calculation tracks realized gain by lot, applies the long-term or short-term rate, and stops before the estimated tax crosses the cap. That leaves residual drift, which is exactly what Nicole needs to review.
